title: Concept: Hardcoded IV or nonce (universal) — review required
description: A fixed IV ((?:iv|IV|nonce)s*[=:]s*["'][A-Za-z0-9+/=]{8,}["']) repeats across messages, so patterns survive encryption and GCM-style modes fail catastrophically. Fresh randomness per message (a CSPRNG draw) is the remedy.
applicability: Encryption setup code assigning IVs or nonces; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Pattern leakage and, for nonce-misuse-sensitive modes, full break; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for GCM/CTR reuse.
